Upcoming adjustments
Among the many feedbacks received, one needs to be addressed first: the gradient of difficulty is too steep, resulting in a very large experience gap in this gear.
Therefore, starting from the next period: Hard difficulty enemy health is reduced by about 20%~50%, and damage is reduced by about 7%~11%, among which Hard 5 has the largest reduction.

In the current version, we do see nightmare clearance records that do not rely on transfinite bursts, final laws, and emergency gnomes, which is consistent with the design standards of our internal testing. But for many secrecy keepers, this standard may still be too extreme —— appropriately relaxed, better for everyone.
Therefore, starting from the next period: the health of nightmare difficulty enemies will be reduced by about 5%~15%, giving more people the opportunity to get the newly added silver core rewards.
